clue.text: Loiter in half of London street with daughter and friend

indicators.note: only the back half of the street name is kept, its first five letters dropped

parts.note: Piccadilly is a famous street in central London

explanation.definitionFit: To dilly-dally is to waste time or dawdle, which is a synonym of loiter.

clue.text: University doctor in African port ignoring son's back pain

clue.text: One in long retreat crossing the old area perpetually

clue.text: Wife keeps up a city house, no matter what

clue.text: Oddly loud woman welcoming popular star

clue.text: Wave in swiftly flowing stream?

clue.text: Brief, as June should be when speaking

clue.text: In 31 days, third of region became infested

clue.text: Indulgent emperor and king entering in impressive manner
